title: Six-minute capture — personal ops evidence & manager prep
content:
Purpose: quick, repeatable ritual to capture signal for weekly syncs, 1:1 prep, and performance narratives. Timebox = 6 minutes (set a timer).

How to run (6-min template):
  0:00–0:30 — context line: team / project / sprint week (one phrase)
  0:30–2:00 — what I shipped or moved (3–4 short bullets, one metric per bullet if possible)
  2:00–3:30 — observed impact / customer signal (quotes, slack pings, telemetry spikes)
  3:30–4:30 — blocker / risk (one sentence)
  4:30–5:30 — explicit ask for manager or team (one ask, who + desired outcome)
  5:30–6:00 — quick reflection: one line on learning / change next week

Example entry (fictional):
  context: hosted-api-rate-limiter / Q1 burst tests
  shipped: rolled out 2s token-quotas to beta (reduced backend queue by ~22%)
  impact: 3 customer pings (Sales) + 1 error regression traced to config edge; p95 latency down 120ms for edges
  blocker: need dedicated test job for rollback validation (no automation yet)
  ask: help prioritize a small test job (SRE 1d effort) so we can ship rollback safely
  learning: need earlier smoke-run on canary routes, add to pre-rollout checklist

Notes-to-self / heuristics: 
  - favor measurable verbs (reduced, increased, surfaced) rather than vague wins.
  - capture raw evidence links inline (slack thread id, grafana panel) — makes writeup for 1:1 trivial.
  - one ask = one ask. tiny, specific, not "help with reliability" but "approve 1d SRE slot".
  - don't try to capture everything. this is a signal-first filter.

Manager-prep snippets (paste these into 1:1 agenda):
  - 2 x wins (metric + customer quote).
  - 1 x risk (what I need and why now).
  - 1 growth ask (pairing, feedback, exposure).

Weekly goals ledger (short):
  - Goal: reduce hosted API per-token cost by 8% Q1 (current = baseline 0.29/token).
    This week: tested adaptive batching heuristics on dev, cost sim shows ~4% improvement at 95th percentile.
    Next: run canary on dedicated 1 GPU pool next Tue.

  - Goal: improve onboarding docs for new ops hires (target: 2hr ramp).
    This week: drafted server-side checklist and first-drivebook page. Need feedback from Meera.

Quick checklist before 1:1: 
  - paste last 3 six-minute entries
  - highlight one metric + link to dashboard
  - write one explicit ask (approve / unblock / feedback)

Open items / TODOs (tracked informally):
  - automate six-minute capture export to a personal folder (cron daily) — low priority.
  - follow up with SRE on canary smoke job estimates (Ethan)
  - refine pre-rollout checklist to include rollback smoke script

Micro-prompts for reflection (when stuck):
  - Where did I spend >2 hours this week that moved a metric?
  - Whose work blocked me and how can we make that handoff smoother?
  - If I had one more engineer for 4 weeks, what would I ask them to do?

Random scribbles (low fidelity):
  - customer quote: "latency feels way better" — check which route, ask PM for transcript
  - thought: shorter, repeated rituals beat long, rare writeups for capturing momentum
  - maybe pre-fill template in my notes app with macro (cmd+shift+6)

Sign-off: keep this lightweight. goal is to make weekly evidence capture frictionless so prep for performance convo isn't painful.
